column3: Contour-ploughed fields on the Loess Hills of western Iowa.
column4: Western Iowa. Wind-deposited silt forms fertile but erosion-prone hills; contour farming follows their slopes.

column3: Fog covers houses and forested slopes at Section in Jamaica's Blue Mountains.
column4: Blue Mountains, Jamaica. Moist air rises over high relief, supporting cloud and rainfall.

column4: Natchez, Mississippi. A broad river corridor runs below the bluffs along the state's western boundary.

column4: Makhtesh Ramon, Israel. Differential erosion has excavated a large basin in folded sedimentary rocks; it is not an impact crater.

column3: The Mullica River among trees in Wharton State Forest, New Jersey.
column4: New Jersey Pine Barrens. Sandy ground and shallow groundwater support forest and low-gradient streams.

column4: Quebrada de los Cuervos, Uruguay. A wooded ravine interrupts the surrounding grassland landscape.
